integrity: The proof uses exact Poisson splitting and independent edge clocks. A small-instance checker is reproducible and is not treated as proof of an infinite-population limit.
scientific_limitations: The full fixed-width limit assumes a fixed number of B vertices and a fixed seed count.
Finite stochastic ordering is proved for one seed only; no all-configuration multi-seed finite-size ordering is claimed.
Historical priority beyond accessible primary literature is not independently established.
title: Fixed-width biclique flooding: a Gumbel core and an exponential seed penalty
